summary: Benzie County Central Schools urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate program to maintain essential connectivity infrastructure and avoid diverting resources from classrooms. The comment from a Benzie County Central Schools administrator argues against sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance in providing affordable connectivity for schools and libraries. The administrator urges the FCC to preserve the program and avoid eligibility restrictions based on geography or broadband availability. The comment highlights the practical partnership between the school district and the federal program in maintaining reliable educational infrastructure for student
